description: paper_configs_v3: Qwen3-0.6B spline vs linear feature-match at R=12 (d_t=12288). KAN encoders are FSDP-ignored (fp32, fully replicated): encoder ~52 GiB/GPU; total peak ~76-83 GiB on 146GB. Run on 4 nodes x 2 GPUs (world=8): 1B x 0.95 / (256 x 128) = 29000 steps. 2 nodes also fine. 1B tokens, 2 seeds. Grid refine DISABLED, deduped val, recon_layer_energy_beta=0.5. Reuses paper_v2 activation cache. Results under results/paper/paper_v3_qwen3_06b/.
